title: OverSeer: Multi-Agent World Models Beyond What Agents See

summary: Despite the success of video world models, extending them to multiple agents is difficult because it requires generating several agent-specific video streams that are consistent in time and between agents. To address this gap, we introduce OverSeer, a multi-agent world model that augments egocentric agent views with auxiliary camera views.
takeaways: To address this gap, we introduce OverSeer, a multi-agent world model that augments egocentric agent views with auxiliary camera views.
We conclude that these fixed views provide a simple and efficient way to improve multi-agent world models.

We suggest that, by fixing the auxiliary views in space, they act as a proxy for a world-centric representation: Unlike the agents' views, which can change entirely due to a simple change in agent position, changes in the auxiliary views directly map to localized changes in the world state.
